description: 供給電力量、電力料金 [electricity and power] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 熊本県. 水力発電所及び太陽光発電設備等の供給電力量と料金収入. Coverage: 熊本県. The portal files it under the publisher 熊本県. Its tags are 企業局. It offers 4 resource(s) in xlsx. The portal shows 2025-03-21 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
